objective: Screen a bounded DeepEmbed-style recurrent ChannelMix modulation over the existing addressed/global RWKV attention controller before any causal training.

motivation.attention_path: The projected-KV carrier remains the retrieval carrier and addressed/global RWKV routing remains the attention-side controller.
motivation.deepembed_reference: Use recurrent state to multiplicatively modulate frozen Gemma MLP intermediate channels through normalized state, query gating, SiLU interaction, and bounded tanh projection.
motivation.experimental_question: Does recurrent RWKV state remain materially visible when an outer FFN/ChannelMix path is added to the attention hybrid?

architecture.outer_ffn_placement: Gemma MLP pre-hook plus down_proj pre-hook; recurrent state scales frozen intermediate activation before down projection
architecture.zero_recurrent_identity: Zero recurrent control produces exact projected-only attention and unit FFN channel scale.
architecture.ffn_gain_zero_ablation: Keep addressed/global RWKV attention gain active while setting only outer FFN gain to zero.

causal_conditions.projected_only: Correct-row projected keys, values, occupancy, and surprise with recurrent readout bypassed.
causal_conditions.hybrid_correct: Correct projected bundle plus correct recurrent matrix, position, and previous-source bundle.
causal_conditions.hybrid_zero_recurrent: Correct projected bundle with every recurrent tensor zeroed.
causal_conditions.hybrid_matched_donor_recurrent: Correct projected bundle with the complete write-length-matched donor recurrent bundle.
causal_conditions.hybrid_layer_permuted_recurrent: Correct projected bundle with recurrent bundles cyclically shifted across the 42 layers.
causal_conditions.ffn_gain_zero: Correct projected and recurrent bundles with attention gain unchanged and DeepEmbed FFN gain set to zero.
causal_conditions.prohibited_confound: Projected keys, values, occupancy, surprise, base weights, and adapter weights may not change between conditions.

execution.distribution: one locked source/donor pair per rank; no gradient synchronization or optimizer update

stopping_rule.pass: Authorize a separately locked causal training run only for the selected DeepEmbed candidate.
stopping_rule.failure: Archive the signed structural failure and do not open the native held-out or protected endpoints.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, unused strength holdout, or native generation.

claim_policy.screen_pass: May claim only that a fixed projected carrier has a BF16-visible incremental dependence on recurrent RWKV state through both addressed attention and DeepEmbed FFN modulation.
claim_policy.screen_failure: Must report that the tested DeepEmbed FFN gains did not satisfy the causal materiality and identity controls.
claim_policy.native_gain: Forbidden without later matched training, open native evaluation, and correct/zero/donor/layer-permuted controls.
